name: KARR vehicle security
description: KARR / Quantam / Gridtraq vehicle-security units (QT/DR): advertisement decode from real old-format MSD captures, Transparent UART peripheral sim, and central lock/unlock menu.
author: BLESPloit device library
notes: Based on KARR Security (com.whgos.swdscustomerapp) and real field captures. Real units use legacy ADV with Complete Local Name + Flags + 6-byte old MSD (not 26-byte extended). GATT profile cloned from 60:8A:10:26:E9:B0 capture (ISSC Transparent UART 49535343-FE7D-… / 49535343-1E4D-… plus unused ISSC airpatch/EEPROM services). Observer requires QT/DR name or company 5451/5244; recovers GAP name from raw ADV when device_name is empty (fixes icon-only empty decode on peripheral sim). Peripheral sim: QtProtocol 0xAA auth + lock/unlock; updates armed bit in 6-byte MSD and name from BD addr (QT + last 4 octets). Central quick_auth uses vars.auth_key (Base64/hex), vars.auth_mode (OldHash), vars.serial; 8-byte challenge→OldHash, 32-byte→AES-128-CBC NewHash.
